title: Keep Score
briefing: Orchard Foods is climbing slowly. Scalper Sam will trade it every day. Watch your cash, holdings and portfolio value, and count the fees.
objective: Profit = final portfolio value − starting cash. Fees come out of every trade.
debrief: Orchard Foods rose gently all match, with steady sales news on day 12. Scalper Sam bought and sold almost every day, paying a fee and the spread each time, so most of his gains went on costs. A player who bought once and held paid one small fee, and the shares still held on the last day counted at the final close.
